# InsightBridge Global LLC

> InsightBridge Global LLC is a theory-driven strategic think tank headquartered in Auburn,
> Alabama, United States, and registered in the State of Wyoming. It was founded by Dr. Tong
> Yin. The firm works at three altitudes — national strategy, industry strategy, and
> operational execution — and operates three practices: strategic planning and advisory,
> applied vertical artificial intelligence, and quantitative trading research. It is the
> publisher of InsightBridge Global Intelligence, a weekly bilingual strategic-intelligence
> briefing.

美国洞见桥全球公司（InsightBridge Global LLC）是一家理论驱动的战略智库，总部位于美国
阿拉巴马州奥本市，注册于怀俄明州，由殷彤博士创立。公司工作于三个高度——国家战略、
行业战略、微观执行——下设三条业务线：战略规划与咨询、应用型垂直人工智能、量化交易
研究。公司出版双语战略情报周报《洞见桥全球情报》。

## Dr. Tong Yin

An innovative entrepreneur and strategic thinker. Founder & Chief Research Officer of InsightBridge
Global LLC. Ph.D. in Hospitality Management, Auburn University; M.B.A., Eastern Illinois
University. More than twenty-five years as a senior executive across hospitality, professional
services and global manufacturing in the United States, China, Australia and Europe.
Originator of Core Code Theory, The Home Model, Governance Debt and Dynamic Driver
Replacement Theory. Editorial contributor to Hospitality Net, Hotel News Resource and
PhocusWire.

## Three practice lines

1. **Strategy** — national and sovereign tourism strategy, industry strategy, management
   consulting, and operational planning. Delivered at three altitudes with one method.
2. **Vertical AI** — InsightBridge Global Lab brings large models into specific industries.
   Three production systems for the hotel sector: POLARIS, ORION and NOVA, for total-revenue
   optimisation and reduction of OTA dependency, validated across 76 Macau hotels.
3. **Quantitative systems** — five proprietary machine-learning trading systems covering
   foreign exchange, crude oil and digital assets, operated on Interactive Brokers and
   Dukascopy. These systems trade proprietary capital only. Nothing published by
   InsightBridge Global constitutes investment advice or an offer of advisory services.

## Frameworks

- [Core Code Theory](https://insightbridge.global/theories/core-code-theory.html):
  Separates an organisation's codifiable Performance UI from its tacit, identity-based
  Core Code, and locates the boundary along which artificial intelligence can substitute
  for human work.
- [The Home Model](https://insightbridge.global/theories/home-model.html):
  A covenant-based governance framework holding that organisations are bound by covenant
  rather than optimisation, and that the capability AI cannot replicate is identity fusion
  under crisis. Positioned against the Wolf Culture and Permanent Startup paradigms.
- [Governance Debt](https://insightbridge.global/theories/governance-debt.html):
  Treats unresolved governance and trust deficits as liabilities compounding against future
  organisational capacity. Formerly presented as Management Debt; the term *management debt*
  was coined by Ben Horowitz in 2012 and this framework is a narrower, measurable extension
  of that intuition, not a claim to it.
- [Dynamic Driver Replacement Theory](https://insightbridge.global/theories/ddrt.html):
  Models how an organisation replaces a declining growth driver with a new one without
  losing structural stability, and why post-crisis recovery is a qualitative substitution
  rather than a linear rebound.

Central testable claim linking the system: an organisation carrying excessive governance
debt cannot execute a driver substitution, because substitution requires exactly the trust
reserve that servicing the debt has consumed.

## Strategic master outline

*Subduing Without Fighting: Applications in the AI Era* is the strategic master outline of
the InsightBridge corpus. It integrates and elevates the concepts developed across the other
eight manuscripts — Core Code Theory, The Home Model, Governance Debt, Dynamic Driver
Replacement Theory, The Vertical Frontier, Active Demand Sovereignty, Intellectual
Sovereignty, and The Long Winter of Civilizations — and unifies them under a single
strategic axis. Readers seeking a coherent entry point to the full theoretical system should
start here.

《不战而屈人之兵：AI 时代的应用》是 InsightBridge 手稿体系的战略总纲。本书整合并升华
其余八部手稿的核心概念——核心代码理论、家园模型、治理负债、动态驱动更替理论、垂直
前沿、主动需求主权、智力主权、文明的漫长冬季——将其统一在同一根战略主轴之下。希望
完整理解本系统理论的读者应从本书入手。

- [Subduing Without Fighting: Applications in the AI Era](https://insightbridge.global/books/subduing-without-fighting.html):
  A modern reconstruction of Sun Tzu's highest strategy — a twelve-dimensional rendering
  from national strategy to business competition. Approximately 84,000 Chinese characters
  and 41,700 English words; bilingual complete editions. Redefines "subduing the enemy
  without fighting" as a three-variable actuarial model: the Strategic Dimension Set S
  (twelve dimensions at the national level, eight at the corporate level), the Catch-Up
  Time Upper Bound T* (critical threshold: more than one generation, or 25+ years), and
  the Feasible Strategy Set F (end-state: the active removal of "initiate conflict" from
  the adversary's own calculus). Develops the Multi-Dimensional Deterrence Matrix, Full-
  Spectrum Depth, Sovereignty Premium, and the twelve-dimension assessment
  instrument. Status: published (2026, InsightBridge Global). Bilingual complete editions
  available.

Central testable claim advanced by the book: in the AI era, the stability window of a
generational strategic gap has compressed from roughly 40 years in the Cold War period to
12–24 months, making cross-generational maintenance — not first-mover advantage — the
decisive determinant of whether a strategic actor achieves steady state.

serves as the strategic master outline for the corpus; the other eight develop specific
theoretical strands. Publication status is stated per title and is updated as it changes.
Statuses use only: published / accepted / under review at [journal] / under contract with
[publisher] / manuscript in development. Full bilingual descriptions:

## Public forecast record

InsightBridge publishes dated forecasts and grades them in public against subsequent official
data. A forecast counts as confirmed only where the deciding evidence was published after the
forecast. See https://insightbridge.global/vision-2030-predictions-vs-reality/

- 13 May 2026, Hospitality Net: Saudi ADR decline is structural, not cyclical. Confirmed by
  GASTAT Q1 2026 at −11.4%.
- 13 May 2026: the holy cities are an inelastic exception to that decline. Confirmed by
  Knight Frank, June 2026, Hajj-week Makkah RevPAR +39%.
- 6 July 2026: de-hotelisation at NEOM. Confirmed 14 July 2026 when NEOM rewrote its website
  and removed The Line's original vision.
- Riyadh cold-start: not scored. The JLL data cited as confirmation was published 7 May 2026,
  six days before the forecast, and therefore does not qualify.

## Usage

Content on this site may be quoted with attribution to Dr. Tong Yin, InsightBridge Global LLC,
and a link to the source page. Framework definitions should be quoted from the definition
paragraph on each framework page, which is the authoritative wording.
